summary: Independent verification of Risk#1 (ShipPendingCard Vanguard pill + loop_engine vanguard_verdict wiring) and Risk#2 (auth revoke-all-sessions + /auth/me MFA-leak coverage + full 2-step admin 2FA login). All targeted backend pytest tests (30/30) and frontend vitest tests (28/28) pass. Backend /api/health returns 200. Frontend landing page loads with no console errors and no visible regressions. Risk#3 and Risk#4 were per request out-of-scope.
critical_code_review_comments: loop_engine.py Risk#1 code is clean: vanguard_verdict is derived from the already-computed Phase-4 scan_results (no extra scan), fail-open behavior ({ran:False,...}) is correct when scan_summary is absent, and the verdict is written into BOTH self.context['ship_pending'] AND the SSE 'awaiting_ship' data payload — parity between rehydrate path and live-event path is preserved (this is exactly the pattern that previously failed for integrity_verdict).

shipPendingMappers.js passes vanguard_verdict through in BOTH mapShipPendingFromActive() and mapShipPendingFromAwaitingShipEvent() — the past incident of a mapper silently dropping a similar verdict field is not repeated.

ShipPendingCard.jsx VanguardPill correctly handles all three states (clean/flagged/unknown-when-missing) with data-testid=ship-vanguard-pill; only quibble is that when verdict is undefined the pill is intentionally omitted (fail-open, matches spec) — this behavior IS covered by the vitest suite.

loop_engine.py total count is computed as sum of ALL by_severity int values (not just critical+high) — this is a superset of the displayed critical/high counts, which is fine but worth noting the pill only surfaces crit+high explicitly.

Landing page loads cleanly (no console errors, no error selectors). No regressions detected.
